recent: Dvorak (upper body) was injured in Saturday's prospects game versus the San Jose Sharks and is set to be evaluated further Sunday, John Hoven of SiriusXM NHL Network Radio reports.
Lund sustained an apparent upper-body injury during Saturday's prospect game versus the Los Angeles Kings, Max Miller of NHL.com reports.
Blankenburg signed a professional tryout offer with Toronto on Saturday, per Andre Leal of The Hockey News.
Sahlin Wallenius is questionable for the San Jose Sharks' upcoming prospect showcase for an undisclosed reason, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports Friday.
